title: finding(spec): hook.form.ts declares the hook `condition` row `language: 'javascript'`, but `HookSchema.condition` is a CEL predicate, so the Studio edits it as JavaScript and objectui cannot route it as an expression
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a declared form row that contradicts the slot it edits, with a named landing site. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by objectui's `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from the objectstack-ai/objectui#10963 dev report (a `needs_decision` stop), read again on objectstack `origin/main`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The contradiction (objectstack `origin/main`)
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`, Execution section: `{ field: 'condition', type: 'code', language: 'javascript', colSpan: 2, helpText: 'Optional formula — skip the hook when this evaluates to false' }`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`: `condition: EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.optional().describe('Predicate (CEL); hook runs only when TRUE …')`.
- Every other predicate row the forms declare says `language: 'expression'`: the `field.form.ts` rows `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`, and `object.form.ts`'s field rows and formula `expression`.
- `javascript` is also what the real script rows declare (hook `body.source`, action `source`). So a consumer cannot tell this predicate apart from a script by its declaration.

## Why it matters
- The Studio's hook edit page renders the served form through objectui's `SchemaForm`. No hook preview is registered. So this row opens in `CodeWidget` with a `javascript` header and JavaScript highlighting over a CEL predicate.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#10963 fixes `CodeWidget` to read and write `language: 'expression'` rows through the ADR-0089 envelope. Keyed on the declared language (seat ruling on that card), the fix reaches seven of the eight predicate rows. This row stays on the string path, showing `[object Object]` for a stored envelope and writing a bare string over it, until its declaration says `expression`.
- Named producer: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts` authors two hook conditions.

## Direction (for triage to grade)
- Change the row to `language: 'expression'`, and make the `helpText` say "CEL predicate", like its siblings.
- Pin it with the forms' existing row-language assertions, if one exists (`hook-body.test.ts` already asserts `language: 'expression'` elsewhere).
- The live Studio reads the form from the running server (`/meta/types`), so no objectui pin bump is needed on that path. objectui's bundled offline fallback picks it up at its next spec bump.

## Dedupe
A semantic search of objectstack issues (hook.form condition row, language javascript, CEL predicate) found only #7175 (closed: `HookSchema.condition`'s SQL `@example`), which is a different defect.
